info.name: ACME Facility Incidents — Steps 3-5
info.description:
API contract for the four Lambda services.

**Run 'Auth > Login as admin' first** — it stores the bearer token in the {{token}} collection variable, which every other request uses via the collection-level auth setting.

baseUrl defaults to the Vite dev server on :3000, which proxies /api/{service} to each Lambda Function URL and preserves the Authorization header. Do NOT use the scaffold's :3001 CORS proxy for authenticated calls: it forwards only accept, content-type, user-agent and host, so the token is dropped and every request arrives anonymous. Point baseUrl at the CloudFront domain for a deployment.

Seeded logins all share the password LocalDev!2026 — see backend/_shared/seed.py.

exec: pm.test('does not reveal whether the account exists', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('identical message to a wrong password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
